clips.send: Hundred-Plant Garden and Three-Flavour Study. Today: Lu Xun’s Native Place, Shaoxing, Zhejiang. The garden behind Lu Xun’s family home and, across a little river, the old private school where he studied. Both can still be visited — compare them with his essay!
